test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘What is the value of (1+x²)/(1-x)div(1-x⁴)/(x-1)times (x(1-x))/((1+x))?
solution:
Given

 (1+x²)/(1-x)div(1-x⁴)/(x-1)times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculation:**

 (1+x²)/(1-x)times (x - 1)/(1-x⁴)times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

 (1+x²)/(1-x)times (-(1-x))/(1-x⁴)times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

- (1+x²)/(1-x⁴)times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

- (1+x²)/((1-x²)(1+x²))times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

 (-1)/((1-x²))times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

 (-1)/((1-x)(1 + x))times (x(1-x))/((1+x))

 (-1)/((1 + x))times (x)/((1+x))

 (-x)/((1 + x)²)

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
